*Founding Full Stack Engineer (Equity-First)
*
Bengaluru | Founding Team | Full-Time

About Vantrix Screen

Hiring hasn’t changed much in decades. We believe it should.

Vantrix Screen is building an AI-native technical assessment platform that helps companies identify exceptional engineering talent through practical evaluations, structured interviews, and intelligent automation.

We’re still early, moving fast, and building the company from first principles.

We’re looking for someone who wants to build—not just code.

⸻

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Founding Engineering Lead to work directly with the founder in building the engineering foundation of Vantrix Screen.

This isn’t a traditional engineering management role.

You’ll write code.

You’ll design systems.

You’ll influence product.

You’ll speak with customers.

You’ll shape engineering culture.

You’ll help build the company from day one.

If you’re looking for a comfortable corporate role, this probably isn’t for you.

If you’re excited about building a company that could redefine technical hiring, we’d love to talk.

⸻

What You’ll Do

Build core platform capabilities end-to-end.
Design scalable backend and frontend architecture.
Ship product rapidly with high engineering standards.
Participate in product strategy and roadmap discussions.
Work closely with customers to understand pain points.
Hire and mentor the early engineering team.
Establish engineering culture, processes, and best practices.
Own technical decisions across the platform.
⸻

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience.
Strong Full Stack engineering skills.
Excellent system design fundamentals.
Strong product thinking.
Comfortable wearing multiple hats.
Exceptional ownership and execution.
Strong communication skills.
Curious, humble, and willing to learn.
Bonus Points

Graduate from a premier engineering institution.
Startup experience.
Built products from scratch.
Experience with AI/LLM-based products.
Technical leadership experience.
⸻

Tech Stack

We’re pragmatic rather than opinionated.

You’ll help shape our stack, but familiarity with some of the following is valuable:

TypeScript
React
Next.js
Node.js
Python
PostgreSQL
Docker
AWS
AI APIs / LLMs
⸻

Compensation

This is an equity-first founding role.

We are looking for builders who believe in creating long-term value.

Competitive startup salary
Meaningful ESOP / Equity
Opportunity to become one of the earliest members of the founding engineering team
⸻

Why Join?

You’ll work directly with the founder.

You’ll influence every important technical decision.

You’ll build a product from zero to scale.

You’ll own meaningful equity.

You’ll help build a company—not just software.

⸻

Our Ideal Candidate

Someone who would rather build the next great product than optimise for the next salary hike.

Someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, shipping fast, and taking ownership.

Someone who wants to look back in five years and say, “I helped build this from the beginning.”
